WORKLOG / TEST DOSSIER — task 0 of insured_plan_authorizations_and_balances (category plan, Insured Plan of Care), Piedmont Motion Physical Therapy.

0. STEP 0 — DRAW, SCOPE, THESIS
- draw_counts.py --task 0 printed: {"prerequisite_problems": 3, "problems": 4, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5, 6]}. Assignment: coinsurance correction 4 factors, non-covered visit charge 5, refundable credit 5, pre-visit amount 6 (multiset [4,5,5,6] = draw). --tasks 2 shows task 1: 2 prerequisite problems, factor counts [4,5,5].
- Occupied before this task: nothing (task 0 is the first). Claimed here: plan_ext_coinsurance_correction (plan_patient_adjustment / billing_error_correction), plan_ext_noncovered_visit_charge (plan_patient_charge_posted / non_covered_service), plan_ext_credit_refund (plan_patient_refund), plan_ext_previsit_payment (plan_patient_payment, owner=user). Reserved headroom for task 1 (3 problems): the authorization side of the line — signing a non-covered waiver (plan_waiver_signed, owner=user), an authorization extension request and a retroactive authorization request (plan_auth_requested) on a prior-authorization tier (Commercial POS / HMO / Medicaid). None of those events, tools or base policies (plan_evt_authorization_requests, plan_visit_authorization's authorization gate) is touched here, so task 1 keeps an independent, load-bearing tree.
- Design thesis. Surface goal (customer's words): pay ahead of time for this afternoon's knee visit. Core scored parameter: the pre-visit amount on the active HDHP knee plan (201.76), paid by the patient herself (owner=user tool). Prerequisite chain the agent must discover from policy: pre-visit amount <- (state gate) a refund entry on every discharged plan in credit <- (value inputs) the refundable credit is fixed only after overstated coinsurance carries a billing error correction, and not worked out until visits past the visit limit under a waiver carry their non-covered charge. Depth: 2 hops (Pay -> Refund -> {Correction, Non-covered charge}); breadth: 20 factors across 4 computations reading the two plan ledgers (87 event rows), the appointment series and its history, the wellness membership and the Patient Payment Plan with its history.

1. WHY THIS IS A GOOD TEST
A front-desk billing specialist taking a pre-visit payment must first notice that the patient's other, discharged plan sits in credit that the practice owes back, then discover that the credit itself is not final until two billing errors on that plan are fixed: a coinsurance charge keyed on the billed charge instead of the EOB (65.00 for a re-evaluation) and a non-covered visit under a signed waiver that was never charged. Each of the four numbers needs ledger reconciliation (sums, latest entries, one- and three-month windows by date of service, payment clearing days), tier parameters of two payer programs (PPO vs HDHP), and cross-product reads (series slot length, late arrival minutes, unpaid late-cancel fee, wellness membership, payment plan standing). Nothing is guessable from the customer, who knows no amount; the difficulty is in reading the published rules and the records, never in choosing between near-synonymous tools.

2. POLICIES CLAIMED, BASE LINEAGE, TRIGGERS, OVERWRITES
- plan_ext_coinsurance_correction: trigger state_due; subject plan_patient_adjustment; base_policy_refs plan_evt_balance_adjustments (governs the subject; its sentence 'A charge posted above what the payer's explanation of benefits or the benefits on file support is corrected by a billing_error_correction for the excess' is refined, not contradicted), plan_evt_time_of_service_collection (how coinsurance/deductible/copay were posted), plan_visit_authorization ('Timed units are counted by unit_counting_method and capped at max_timed_units_per_visit', 'A telehealth_treatment visit is billed only where telehealth_covered is true'). overwrite [] — base gives no figure for the supported share, so the extended computation does not differ from a base provision for the same quantity.
- plan_ext_noncovered_visit_charge: state_due; subject plan_patient_charge_posted; refs plan_agg_benefit_visit_limit, plan_evt_time_of_service_collection (both govern the subject). overwrite: plan_agg_benefit_visit_limit clause 'the patient is then charged self_pay_visit_rate as a non_covered_service charge' replaced by 'The patient is charged the non-covered visit charge as a non-covered service charge in place of a flat self-pay visit rate.' (the extended charge differs from the flat 118.00). The waiver gate (waiver signed before the visit date on a tier allowing non-covered billing) is not quoted and stays in force.
- plan_ext_credit_refund: state_due; subject plan_patient_refund; refs plan_evt_payment_application (governs; card-window and 'never exceeds the payment' clauses inherited), plan_evt_time_of_service_collection (EOB posting that the coinsurance hold anticipates). overwrite: 'any remaining credit is refunded within credit_refund_days calendar days after it arose' replaced by 'The credit standing on the plan is refunded, less the holds set out below, within the payer program's credit refund period after it arose.' (holds make the refund differ from 'remaining credit').
- plan_ext_previsit_payment: on_request; subject plan_patient_payment; refs plan_evt_payment_application (governs; gate payment_plan_not_closed inherited; 'applied to the oldest open charge by posting date' used for source_event_id), plan_evt_time_of_service_collection. overwrite (round-2 revision, audit F-D1): two clauses of plan_evt_time_of_service_collection are declared superseded for a payment taken ahead of a visit — 'a deductible_estimate charge of the lower of the visit's allowed amount, the deductible remaining and tos_deductible_estimate_cap is posted' replaced by 'When a patient pays ahead of a visit, the deductible part of that payment is capped by the patient's Patient Payment Plan standing as set out below, in place of the lower-of-three deductible estimate the visit would otherwise collect at the time of service.', and 'the coinsurance and any deductible shown on the payer's explanation of benefits are posted ... after the explanation of benefits arrives' replaced by 'When a patient pays ahead of a visit, the coinsurance share above the deductible still to be met is collected with that payment, ahead of the explanation of benefits, in place of waiting for that coinsurance to be posted after it.' The status gate is not quoted and stays in force; the visit's own postings remain the base rule.
- New constants and where they come from: reevaluation_component 45.00 (the office-visit benefit portion of a re-evaluation/progress report visit, the payer pays it under the copay benefit); extended/short self-pay rates 156.00/88.00 (the flat 118.00 is a 45-minute rate; overwrite declared); minutes_per_timed_unit 15 (the timed-unit length behind base unit_counting_method); short_refund_period_days 30, overdue_eob_hold_per_visit 20.00, check/ACH clearing 10/5 days, small_credit_max 10.00 (holds a practice applies before refunding, refining base credit_refund_days); current_payment_plan_cap 75.00 and missed_installment_lookback_months 3 (pre-visit courtesy for patients on a payment plan in good standing). No base parameter value is changed.

3. FACTOR CARD (tier taken / evidence rows / baseline figure; per-factor sensitivity from the Step 5 run)
Coinsurance correction = 57.92 (computation-document fallback 27.40):
- unit_maximum_base (method): billed visit 3f7e6db5-a68b-4756-be23-c5d0f192ae14 re_evaluation 5 units, allowed 188.00 > PPO max 4 units -> prorated 150.40. Baseline (allowed as billed) -> 50.40. Near-miss: the Aug 25 telehealth visit (2 units) is not the reviewed visit, and telehealth is covered on the PPO.
- deductible_taken_first (parameter): deductible charge 33d169c1-0127-469f-9793-136837886d8c 30.00 for 2026-09-08 -> 30.00. Baseline 0 -> 51.92.
- copay_taken_first (parameter): PPO collects copay at TOS, copay charge 40646b0d-a8c1-48c9-8e27-75a7cef41c4e 40.00 -> 40.00. Baseline 0 -> 49.92.
- office_visit_component (parameter): visit kind re_evaluation -> 45.00. Baseline 0 -> 48.92.
Non-covered visit charge = 72.32 (fallback 118.00):
- slot_rate (parameter, cross-difficulty series): series 80289e40-4326-4aac-ae30-5afaf1063b67 Extended 60-Minute (60 min >= 53) -> 156.00. Baseline 118.00 -> 44.96.
- minutes_delivered (method, series): attendance 6906222d-9b09-454e-8d62-b264076bd70f minutes_late 12 <= grace 15, series shortens late visits -> 48. Baseline 60 -> 100.40.
- time_ratio (method): PPO ama_substantial_portion, treatment visit -> 48/60 = 0.8. Baseline 1 -> 100.40. (Near-miss: under the CMS rule 48 minutes would be 3 of 4 units = 0.75; the PPO tier is AMA.)

Refundable credit = 78.08 (fallback 25.00), on the world after the correction and the non-covered charge:
- pending_eob_hold (method): PPO bills after EOB, refund period 30 <= 30 -> one-month window, 20% x (150.40 + 150.40 + 0.00) - 0 = 60.16. Baseline 0 -> 138.24.

Baseline 0 -> 118.08. Near-miss: the Jun 1 evaluation carries no coinsurance but is more than 3 months back and an evaluation.
- uncleared_funds (parameter): check 7fd00ad1-5813-4c85-849e-4e76db6ad474 95.00 on Oct 1 is 13 days old (cleared, >= 10: near-miss), bank transfer c84e82cc-50c3-4e24-93b6-8c7102f219eb 25.00 on Oct 12 is 2 days old (< 5) -> 25.00. Baseline 0 -> 103.08.
- other_hold (parameter, cross-difficulty series): series 80289e40-4326-4aac-ae30-5afaf1063b67 missed_fee_balance 45.00, late-cancel fee ca9d4056-e5af-4df8-9890-62b3d0b63a34 assessed Aug 19 (56 days > 30 due days) -> 45.00. Baseline 0 -> 123.08.

Near-miss: the Sep 28 duplicate card payment e63dc8c1-52f4-40cc-bfba-38e622a06f97 looks like 'the' payment to refund, but the rule returns against the most recent card payment.
Pre-visit amount = 201.76 (fallback 269.60), on the world after the refund:
- expected_units (method, cross-difficulty series): active series 4d33572c-7566-4f63-8505-eed7f0710757 60 min -> 4 units. Baseline latest visit 3 units -> 195.02.
- allowed_per_unit (method): latest 4-unit visit Oct 9 146.80 -> 36.70. Baseline latest visit Oct 12 113.10/3 = 37.70 -> 202.56.
- deductible_still_to_meet (method): an EOB deductible stands (43.40 for the Oct 5 evaluation) -> 610.00 - estimates 488.10 - 43.40 = 78.50. Baseline 610.00 -> 188.10.
- payment_plan_cap (parameter, MULTI-SOURCE, cross-difficulty payplan): payment plan e3364c2a-201c-40a1-905b-310001254375 active AND its most recent installment (due Sep 15) paid Sep 15, on its due date -> 75.00. Baseline 125.00 -> 205.26.
- share_beyond_deductible (method): 146.80 > 78.50, coinsurance 20% -> 13.66. Baseline 0 -> 188.10.
- carried_balance (parameter): the 43.40 EOB deductible posted Oct 13 waits for its statement (no statement issued on the knee plan), so only the open time-of-service charges are carried: estimates 488.10 - payments 375.00 = 113.10. Baseline: the record balance 156.50, which equals the ledger -> 245.16. Round-2 revision (audit F-D3/F0-2): the record is now consistent with its own ledger; the factor bites through a real collection rule, not a stale cache.
Task floors: multi-source = payment_plan_cap; cross-difficulty = slot_rate, minutes_delivered (series), member_pricing (membership), other_hold (series), expected_units (series), payment_plan_cap (payplan); every one reads seeded rows.

4. BASE-INVARIANT CARD
- Correction (plan_patient_adjustment): plan_evt_balance_adjustments.final_statement_aged (time; anchor care_plan_events.event_date of the final statement; duration variants.statement_cycle_days = 30; counting 'Days are counted as calendar days from the statement date, the statement date itself being day zero.'; not_before; inclusive). This gate restrains collections transfers; the blueprint applies it to every plan_patient_adjustment. Base defect noted and routed around without touching the blueprint: the back plan has only statement number 1 (Aug 20, Sep 23), both paid, no final statement number 3 exists, no collections transfer is written, so the gate does not engage for a billing error correction; declared satisfied with the statement row fd17a1be-780d-4294-813c-bddfbd6eb663 as evidence. Positive case: a collections transfer 30 days after a final statement passes; negative: 29 days fails.
- Non-covered charge (plan_patient_charge_posted): waiver_before_noncovered_visit — waiver 0777f600-b3fb-4fd3-a552-672a4d25b7c0 commercial_waiver signed 2026-09-22 for visit_date 2026-09-29 (before the visit), PPO tier non_covered_waiver_form commercial_waiver and non_covered_billing_allowed true; correlation care_plan_events.visit_date = 2026-09-29 = the tool's visit_date. plan_not_closed_for_charges — back plan status discharged (allowed set intake/active/on_hold/discharged).
- Refund (plan_patient_refund): plan_evt_payment_application has no gate for refunds -> policy_scope; inherited clauses: credit first offset against other open charges on the same plan (there are none: every charge on the back plan is paid, transferred or corrected), original card within 120 days of the card payment, never more than the payment returned.
- Pre-visit payment (plan_patient_payment): payment_plan_not_closed — knee plan 5de29668-4fd7-4e5d-a9bb-b03374d0eba1 status active.

5. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD
- Correction: target = the coinsurance charge 763b6f88-a1d0-45cc-a0e5-b396b4261207 (posted 2026-09-29, visit 2026-09-08, 65.00) and its billed visit 3f7e6db5-a68b-4756-be23-c5d0f192ae14; included rows for the supported share: deductible 33d169c1-0127-469f-9793-136837886d8c and copay 40646b0d-a8c1-48c9-8e27-75a7cef41c4e of the same visit date; excluded: all other coinsurance charges (each already equal to its supported share: 22.08 for 150.40-allowed treatment visits = 20% x (150.40 - 40.00), 15.56 for the Aug 11 progress report = 20% x (162.80 - 40.00 - 45.00), none for the Jun 1 evaluation). The tool writes source_event_id = the charge corrected.
- Non-covered charge: target = billed visit 29f24faf-c5ce-42d7-bfc6-1b2a4a557f22 (2026-09-29, 3 units, allowed 0.00); included: its copay 26e3495e-eed0-427e-a7f5-90ad7d077951 and the 40.00 payment applied to it; attendance 6906222d-9b09-454e-8d62-b264076bd70f in series 80289e40-4326-4aac-ae30-5afaf1063b67. Visit-limit count: 14 used elsewhere + 17 dates of service on the back plan = 31 > 30, so only Sep 29 runs past the limit (Sep 22 is the 30th).
- Refund: target = the back plan's credit; payment returned = c6c4242a-5362-48d2-a6f4-21887db60a2e (Sep 30 card deposit 200.00); excluded as the source: the duplicate e63dc8c1-52f4-40cc-bfba-38e622a06f97 (older card payment), the Oct 1 check 7fd00ad1-5813-4c85-849e-4e76db6ad474 and Oct 12 bank transfer c84e82cc-50c3-4e24-93b6-8c7102f219eb (not card payments, and both inside or near clearing). Payment-plan transfers (88.32, Jul 24) are adjustments on the ledger; the June coinsurance they moved is settled through the Patient Payment Plan.
- Pre-visit payment: target = knee plan 5de29668-4fd7-4e5d-a9bb-b03374d0eba1; applied to the oldest open charge = the Oct 12 deductible estimate bc920e7a-1880-4621-be4e-0c7cf2511e89 (113.10, unpaid); the Oct 5/7/9 estimates each carry an equal HSA payment; the 43.40 EOB deductible (posted Oct 13) is younger.

6. WORLD ROWS AND WHY EACH EXISTS
- customers: Denise Abernathy (phone 9195550147, DOB 1972-05-09, ZIP 27615, account PM-3106214) — locate and verify.
- care_plans: back plan 3afe36a3-ee64-45e1-928d-e291b59a938d (discharged, cache -262.64 = ledger credit) and the knee plan (active, record 156.50 = ledger: estimates 488.10 + EOB deductible 43.40 - payments 375.00).

Sep 29 12 minutes late, Aug 18 late cancellation with 3 hours' notice and its fee, 3 attended knee visits incl. Oct 12 14 minutes late within grace).

7. PROBLEM-TREE CARD
Root: plan_ext_previsit_payment (customer's request). Edges:
(a) plan_ext_credit_refund <- plan_ext_coinsurance_correction, value_input, gate adjustments_total, form state, sentence 'The refundable credit is fixed only after every coinsurance charge on the plan that is higher than the share its explanation of benefits supports carries a billing error correction.' (affirmative). Opening: 763b6f88-a1d0-45cc-a0e5-b396b4261207.amount 65.00 vs supported 7.08, no correction row. Resolved by correct_overposted_coinsurance_fd44d809 (agent). Only that tool writes a billing_error_correction in this difficulty.
(b) plan_ext_credit_refund <- plan_ext_noncovered_visit_charge, value_input, gate charges_total, form state, sentence 'The refundable credit is not worked out until each visit on the plan that ran past the payer's visit limit under a signed waiver carries its non-covered service charge.' (negated). Opening: 29f24faf-c5ce-42d7-bfc6-1b2a4a557f22 allowed 0.00, waiver 0777f600-b3fb-4fd3-a552-672a4d25b7c0, no non_covered_service row. Resolved by post_noncovered_visit_charge_a3bfc726 (agent); only that tool writes a non_covered_service charge.
(c) plan_ext_previsit_payment <- plan_ext_credit_refund, state_gate, gate care_plan_events.event_type, form state, sentence 'A pre-visit amount is not taken from a patient until each discharged plan of care of that patient whose ledger shows a credit carries a refund issued since its discharge.' (negated). Opening: 3afe36a3-ee64-45e1-928d-e291b59a938d discharged 2026-09-30 with ledger credit 262.64, no refund row. Resolved by issue_credit_refund_cc5fc5ad (agent); only that tool writes plan_patient_refund.
Four-point test, each sentence: ordering connective present (only after / not ... until); waited-on side is a record-visible state named in record words (coinsurance charge carrying a billing error correction; visit carrying its non-covered service charge; discharged plan in credit carrying a refund); no tool, id or snake_case token; scope exact (every overstated coinsurance charge; each visit past the limit under a signed waiver; each discharged plan in credit). Derivation: sentence + records (the 65.00 charge, the uncharged waiver visit, the discharged plan in credit) + the depended-on rules (the correction 'is booked as a billing error correction against that charge'; the non-covered visit charge is posted 'as a non-covered service charge'; the refundable credit is refunded) -> exactly one resolving write each.
Topological order: correction, non-covered charge (either order), refund, pre-visit payment. value_input edges: 2 (>= max(3-1,1)). User write: pay_previsit_amount_3bf14ac0 (owner=user), handed over after the refund.
Per-edge deletion run (Step 5): skip the correction -> refundable credit 20.16 instead of 78.08; skip the non-covered charge -> 150.40 instead of 78.08; skip the refund -> no refund row and the pre-visit gate unmet (pre-visit amount itself unchanged, a state gate). Parallel edges: correction and charge commute; both orders give identical terminal tables (True) and the same refund.
No real-world wait: every write is a ledger entry the practice books on the spot; the refund is issued on the spot to the card (its settlement time is not a prerequisite of anything); the payment is the patient's own card authorization in the call.

8. PERSONA DESIGN
Denise is brisk and practical, calls from work, volunteers only the goal (pay ahead, for today's 3:30 knee visit, what the front desk would collect at check-in; statement-billed amounts she pays when the statement comes, as she always does), her HSA-card preference and that she wants to enter the payment herself. Identity details only when asked (name + phone to locate; DOB + ZIP to verify; email/account only if asked; Aetna member number only if asked). Back therapy is mentioned only if the agent asks about other therapy. Conditional reactions: consent to whatever must be done on the back account once told; acceptance of the last-session charge (she remembers signing the limit form a week before) and of a refund to the card used at discharge only after the agent says so; acceptance that Monday's unpaid amount is included (she paid nothing that day) once the agent says so; if the agent mentions the 43.40 EOB deductible not yet on a statement, she keeps it out of today's payment; runs the payment tool with exactly what the agent gives, reads back the confirmation, then closes. She never names an amount, a correction, a refund or a non-covered charge herself.

9. REACHABILITY WALK-THROUGH
Turn 1 goal -> find_customers(phone) -> verify(DOB, ZIP) -> find_care_plans shows the knee plan (target) and the discharged back plan in credit -> KB pre-visit rule's prerequisite sentence sends the agent to the back plan's ledger (find_care_plan_events on both plans) -> refund rule's two prerequisite sentences send it to the 65.00 coinsurance charge and the uncharged Sep 29 waiver visit -> series, series history, membership, payment plan and its history reads supply the cross-difficulty evidence -> correction, non-covered charge (either order), refund (agent tools, customer consents) -> unlock_user_discoverable_tool for the payment, the agent tells her plan reference, charge reference, HSA card and 201.76 -> she calls call_user_discoverable_tool and reads back the confirmation -> close. Every must-ask item (identity, which visit, payment means, consent) has a scripted answer; nothing waits for an outside event.

10. EASY MISTAKES AND HOW THE RULES EXCLUDE THEM
Refunding the whole 262.64 or returning against the Sep 28 duplicate card payment instead of applying the holds and the most-recent-card rule; taking the payment before the refund; computing the coinsurance share on 188.00 (27.40 correction); charging the flat 118.00; carrying the whole knee record balance (156.50) instead of only the open time-of-service charges; taking the 125.00 TOS cap instead of the payment-plan cap; pricing units from the 3-unit Oct 12 visit; holding the Oct 1 check as uncleared (13 days >= 10).

11. STANDARD SOLUTION AND VERIFICATION RUN
Code: /tmp authoring scripts (deleted from the write domain) replayed the gold writes through the real task tools (erlbench DB + ToolContext) and evaluated each compute with check_compute.build_env/eval_compute on its handling-time world, then substituted each factor's baseline. Output: C 57.92 (fallback 27.40); PN 72.32 (fallback 118.00); R 78.08 (fallback 25.00) on the world after C and PN; PAY 201.76 (fallback 269.60) on the world after R; skip-C refund 20.16, skip-PN refund 150.40; swapped order identical (True). Gold: correction(care_plan_id 3afe36a3-ee64-45e1-928d-e291b59a938d, source_event_id 763b6f88-a1d0-45cc-a0e5-b396b4261207, amount 57.92); non-covered charge(care_plan_id 3afe36a3-ee64-45e1-928d-e291b59a938d, visit_date 2026-09-29, source_event_id 29f24faf-c5ce-42d7-bfc6-1b2a4a557f22, amount 72.32); refund(care_plan_id 3afe36a3-ee64-45e1-928d-e291b59a938d, source_event_id c6c4242a-5362-48d2-a6f4-21887db60a2e, refund_method original_card, amount 78.08); patient payment(care_plan_id 5de29668-4fd7-4e5d-a9bb-b03374d0eba1, source_event_id bc920e7a-1880-4621-be4e-0c7cf2511e89, payment_method hsa_fsa_card, amount 201.76).

12. RULE <-> COMPUTE TWO-WAY SWEEP
Forward: every world-reading or choosing binding quotes its rule sentence in compute_basis (e.g. coins_charge_id -> 'The charge reviewed is the coinsurance charge posted most recently...'; pending_eob_hold -> the window sentence; returned_payment_cap -> 'The payment the refund is returned against, and so its ceiling, is chosen in this order...'; estimate_cap -> the Patient Payment Plan standing sentence). Reverse: each rule sentence with a quantity, window, filter, branch, cap or rounding is claimed (the window definition 'A visit is dated within the last N months when fewer than N whole calendar months separate its date of service from today.' is implemented by within_months on visit_date; 'rounded half up to four decimal places' by RND(...,4); 'never below zero' by MX(0,...); 'no larger than the payment' by MN). Grouping and rounding moments are stated (percentage applied once to the remainder; rate x ratio, then discount, then credit, round only at the end; holds subtracted together, then the further hold, then the ceiling).

13. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT
From the published rules, tool schemas, query returns and the persona alone: the pre-visit rule names its wait on a refund for a discharged plan in credit; find_care_plans shows such a plan; the refund rule names its two waits; the back ledger shows the 65.00 coinsurance (correction 57.92 by the coinsurance rule) and the uncharged Sep 29 waiver visit (72.32 by the non-covered rule); the refund then computes to 78.08 against the Sep 30 card payment; the pre-visit amount computes to 201.76 applied to the oldest open charge. Same objects, order and parameters as gold.

14. REVISION LOG
- Symptom: earlier coinsurance history (20% of allowed) contradicted the correction rule (copay taken out first) -> every past charge would have been 'overstated'. If they tell you that what was left unpaid at Monday's visit is included, you say that makes sense, because you did not pay anything at Monday's visit. You do not want anything else changed or sent to you. Once the payment confirmation has come back, you thank them, say you will see the clinic at three-thirty, and end the call.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The correction and the non-covered charge are parallel prerequisites of the refundable credit. They touch disjoint rows (an adjustment and a charge with make_id keys built from their own arguments) and each changes the back plan's balance cache by an additive delta; neither computation reads the other's row (the correction reads coinsurance/deductible/copay charges of Sep 8; the non-covered charge reads Sep 29 copay/estimate payments). Replaying correction-then-charge and charge-then-correction gives the identical world (terminal tables equal: True) and the identical refundable credit (78.08 vs 78.08). The refund must follow both (prerequisite sentences of the refund rule) and the pre-visit payment must follow the refund (its own prerequisite sentence).
